result.summary: Removes the default-value overloads of SettingToString, SettingTo, and SettingToBool in src/common/args. Callers in ArgsManager and the Qt options model now explicitly invoke value_or() on the std::optional returned by the single-argument versions.
result.problem: Maintaining overloaded setting conversion helpers that take default values adds redundant wrapper boilerplate to the arguments interface and introduces function overload ambiguity for refactors such as PR #31260.
evidence: Author notes in description that this "Decreases complexity at the foundation at the only cost of a change to ArgsManager::GetPathArg_() and slightly more verbose code in one leaf; src/qt/optionsmodel.cpp"
Author notes it "represents slight decrease in complexity of pending PR #31260 which has an extra GetPtr() function for disambiguating between overloaded functions"
result.card: Removes overloaded SettingToString, SettingTo, and SettingToBool helpers that accept default values in favor of callers using value_or() directly on the returned std::optional. This eliminates redundant wrapper functions in common/args and removes the need for overload disambiguation helpers in pending settings work like PR #31260. Evidence comes solely from the author demonstrating internal code cleanup and simplification of dependent PRs.

risk.why: A typo in a value_or fallback could cause GUI options or node path arguments to resolve to unintended default values.
